From the design consultants to the crew, every team member at KBF Design Gallery made this process seamless for me. I highly recommend them for your next home renovation project. And, I absolutely love how my enterntainment wall turned out. …

decision_maker.quote: Principals Ashley Sheaffer and Adam Vellequette Owners

assessment: Opinion: award-winning, owner-led Maitland kitchen, bath and whole-home design-build firm with an already sophisticated custom website and in-house marketing staff (team page lists two Marketing roles); weak fit for a website pitch despite strong activity.

name: Newberry Home Improvement

gbp_reviews_visible.text: Had a master bath remodel with new double sink, vanity and shower, and a new tub/shower combo in our spare bath.  Kevin was fabulous! His work is very meticulous. He was very efficient and cleaned up everything! When I got home I couldn’t …

Michael and Eric did an amazing job replacing my old fiberglass tub with this beautiful shower. They were, friendly, polite, professional and punctual. They kept the work area tidy with little to no disruption to my days. I recommend them wholeheartedly!!!

J.t and Austin over at Newberry Home Improvement did a fantastic job, were on time and worked throughout the entire instillation. Cleaned up after job was complete and went over everything regarding warranty and new cabinets.

decision_maker.name: Barry Dyer
decision_maker.quote: With over three decades in the home improvement industry, our owner, Barry Dyer, brings a wealth of expertise

assessment: Opinion: established two-office kitchen and bath remodeler (refacing, tub-to-shower, full remodels) with heavy promo activity, 242 GBP reviews and a named owner; good fit, though the work skews to mid-ticket refacing and bath conversions.
